description: 전남광주통합특별시 함평군_버스 노선정보 [bus and public transit] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 전남광주통합특별시 함평군. 버스정보시스템 노선정보는 우리군과 광주광역시 연결 단위로 운행 중인 버스노선의 기본 특성과 운행정보를 제공하는 데이터로, 노선 아이디, 노선명, 기·종점, 노선종류, 운행시간 등 노선별. Coverage: 전남광주통합특별시 함평군. The portal files it under the publisher 전남광주통합특별시 함평군. Its tags are 버스운행, 버스노선, 대중교통, 버스정류장, 버스위치정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml. The portal shows 2025-11-07 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
